integrity.computational_evidence: Exact SymPy determinant identities and finite-field incidence graph tests accompany but do not replace the analytic proof.
integrity.proof_scope: Universal for existing AD(n,mu) with n >= 2, mu >= 1; reentrant instance is the point-hyperplane design of AG(3,3).

scientific_limitations: Applies to existing affine resolvable designs, with no claim that arbitrary integer parameters occur. Bounded originality review cannot rule out an unindexed equivalent result in coherent-configuration literature. No assertion about non-distance-radial kernels.
title: Reentrant exponential-distance positivity on affine resolvable incidence graphs
